description: Registry of all table definitions — system bootstrap and user domain schemas. Every table in the system has a row here.
Registry of all active tables that SERV-Table is permitted to write to. Acts as a security gatekeeper — tables not listed here are rejected.
Defines business entities that span multiple PGD tables. SERV-Entity reads this to build jsonb_agg queries.
User-facing command aliases and help text per domain. Populated at runtime when a domain is created. Powers /help {domain} responses.
Stores reusable workflow definitions generated by LLM or created manually. Reused across runs — LLM is not called twice for the same workflow.
One row per workflow execution. Holds the execution stack, accumulated state, callback routing, and runtime safety counters.
Append-only audit log — one row per step execution. Never updated after insert. Used for idempotency checks on SQS redelivery and debugging.
Stores LLM prompts with versioning and quality tracking for self-improvement. Self-referential via parent_prompt_id to track prompt evolution history.
Maps user input patterns to workflows or action types for the Intent Preprocessor. workflow_id is nullable — some intents are ad-hoc and have no pre-built workflow.
Reserved for future parallel execution — optimistic locking. NOT used in sequential mode. Bootstrapped empty.
Compact runtime self-description of the system. Injected into heavy-lift LLM prompts so the model knows what it is operating inside, what it can do, and what the rules are.
Canonical catalogue of all valid workflow step types with their input/output contracts. Seeded on bootstrap.
Registry of what this system can currently do. Injected into heavy-lift prompts so the LLM proposes only feasible workflows.
